original_test_intent: Validate the Starting Address of each Type 20 memory-device mapped range using correct legacy/extended rules, tied to the exact Type 17 device and contained within its Type 19 array range before and after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 17/19/20 and OS-map data, bind each Type 20 record to device and array-range handles, select legacy or extended endpoints by sentinel/length, validate paired range containment/interleaving, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user defines expected Type 17/19/20 topology and approves reboot; no DIMM or memory-map change is intrinsic.
required_inputs: SMBIOS version and Type 20 structure length
Legacy/extended address, units and sentinel policy
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS-map queries and do not change DIMMs, mapping, kernel or firmware.
Resolve both Type 17 and Type 19 handles before judging an address.
Pair start/end from the same Type 20 record, preserve raw sentinel/extended values and reject truncation.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on unresolved handle, invalid containment or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve each device and parent-array handle, select the authoritative start representation, validate paired range/containment/interleave policy and compare pre/post reboot.
Report orphan, reversed, overlapping, out-of-parent or drifting ranges without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve device/array address topology, interleaving and reboot plan.
Resolve intentional logical/interleaved mapping differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Starting Address is relevant, but grep loses record identity, authoritative encoding mode, device/array handles, paired end and containment.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 17/19/20 plus OS map; report each Type 20 handle, raw legacy/extended endpoints, resolved device/array, normalized range, containment/interleave result and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 20 Starting Address scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no memory reconfiguration is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select authoritative Type 20 endpoints by sentinel/length, resolve device and parent range, validate paired containment/interleaving, and compare the per-device map after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems with Type 17/19/20 memory mapping.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17/19/20 address and handle definitions plus approved platform topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds encoding selection, dual-handle resolution and parent-range/interleave validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong-device, orphaned, truncated and out-of-array starts missed by isolated grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved device-to-array topology and address/interleave policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS maps may aggregate device mappings; correlation does not replace SMBIOS handle integrity.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define different interleaving and device ranges, but each expected start must remain bound to explicit Type 17 and Type 19 identities; an OS aggregate range cannot silently replace this case.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 17/19/20 topology, address and interleave policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-record raw endpoints, resolved device/array handles, normalized range and containment result
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot per-device diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Starting Address is a valid Type 20 field; expected topology is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Encoding, handle resolution, containment and persistence checks are automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds record identity, address mode, dual-handle topology and containment checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates platform data/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible start value from passing when assigned to the wrong device, outside its parent array or decoded from an inactive field.
independent_technical_reasoning: Device range starts are machine-readable topology facts; full relationship validation is deterministic and requires no manual core observation.
